sloka: शैलांश्च तरुसंचन्नान् वनराजीश्च पुष्पिताः ।अभिचक्राम तेजस्वी हनुमान् प्लवगर्षभः ॥५-२-७॥
transliteration: śailāṁśca tarusaṁcannān vanarājīśca puṣpitāḥ ।abhicakrāma tejasvī hanumān plavagarṣabhaḥ ॥5-2-7॥

translations.english: Brilliant Hanuman, a bull among monkeys, crossed the mountains covered with blossoming trees and forest ranges.
